issue.title: Improve document retrieval with hybrid retrieval
issue.body: Document RAG currently relies on dense vector retrieval only. Exact identifiers such as config keys and file names are missed. We should add BM25 keyword retrieval and fuse the two ranked lists with RRF instead of mixing incomparable scores.
